_comment: Minimal IAM policy for the Dailymattr sending user.
Attach to the SAME IAM user whose access keys are stored in Supabase as
SendOnly is what the daily send needs. The other two statements exist so the
ses-setup-events function can build the bounce feedback loop for you:
SES  -> configuration set -> SNS topic -> https -> email-events function
Without that loop SES accepts mail and bounces silently, which is how a
15.51% bounce rate accumulated unseen until AWS paused the previous account.
The SNS statement is scoped to one topic name so this policy cannot touch
any other topic in the account.
